$comment: Director script for ?director=1 (start at a scene with &scene=<n or id>; add &replay=1 to film a finished run, with &speed=, &t= and &delay=; add &recording=<name> to play that run from a recording bundled with the page, with no network). Keys: → or PageDown next, ← or PageUp previous, space pause (a replay pauses too), z zoom, c captions, Home first scene. Scene fields: id, caption (required); kicker, sub; title (full-screen card); code (caption in the code font); focus (a directory or file path, a list tried in order, or @hot / @sigma / @landing / @selected; null or absent shows the whole map); highlight (paths or directories to outline, or @landing / @needs; more than 40 files dims the rest); emphasize (hero, stats, sigma, vaccine, funnel, trunk); requires (vaccine, landing, review, sigma, direction, mcp: the scene is skipped while the colony has none); tab (events, intents, review, why: opens the side panel); select (a file for the Why tab, or @landing / @hot / @mcp); duration (seconds, auto-advance); maxMs (the longest the beat waits for what it shows, a file to select, a camera target, a read on screen or what requires names, before the director moves on by itself and says why in the console; milliseconds, default 30000; space holds a beat); recording (a recording bundled with the page that the scene plays: on a page playing another run, or a live colony, the director opens /c/<recording>?director=1&replay=1&recording=<recording>&scene=<id> instead); speed (that replay's speed, 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16; the page's own when absent). Captions fill {colony} {files} {violations} {fixed} {fixedLine} {fixedIn} {agents} {working} {landings} {perMin} {decisions} {proof} {proofPct} {reflex} {llm} {human} {review} {sigma} {routed} {routedLine} {amended} {withdrawn} {directives} {direction} {mcpAgent} {mcpFile} {mcpLanded} {recipeFiles} {recipeCommits} {recipeHeld} {recipeBack} {recipeLanded}.

scenes.caption: A colony, not a queue.
scenes.sub: Git coordination for coding agents that share one repository, built on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects and Artifacts.

scenes.caption: Every tile is a file in {colony}.
scenes.sub: {files} files. Size is bytes; color is the field the agents read.

scenes.caption: One person declares one architecture rule.
scenes.sub: Every violation becomes a need in the field: {violations} to fix, and no one assigns them.

scenes.caption: Agents read the field, not each other.
scenes.sub: Needs attract, claims repel, trails fade. {working} agents are working right now.

scenes.caption: Each change goes to the cheapest layer that is sure.
scenes.sub: {proof} of {decisions} settled by proof, without a model. What proof cannot settle goes to Clef decision models, then an LLM, then a person.

scenes.caption: Lanes land non-conflicting changes together.
scenes.sub: Every read is validated against trunk. A stale read goes back quoting the diff of the landing that beat it. {perMin} landings a minute.

scenes.caption: {violations} violations left. {fixedLine}.
scenes.sub: No queue, no scheduler, no lock. The colony repairs toward the shape it was given.

scenes.caption: People change course mid-flight.
scenes.sub: {direction}. Needs move, agents re-orient, and uncommitted work for the old direction is stopped.

scenes.caption: Only uncertainty reaches a person.
scenes.sub: A rejection becomes an antibody, and the next similar change is caught without anyone.

scenes.caption: Review is tested with sealed bad changes.
scenes.sub: The colony seeds deliberately broken changes and counts where review routes them: {routedLine}.

scenes.caption: Every commit carries its why.
scenes.sub: Intent, rule and approver, agent and model, decisions, checks, and what was not verified, in git notes on Artifacts.

scenes.caption: Any agent can join over MCP.
scenes.sub: {mcpAgent} joined from outside, took an intent, and landed {mcpFile} on the same terms as the colony's own agents.

scenes.caption: When rebases cascade, sigma rises past 1.
scenes.sub: The governor slows the lanes and closes admission until the colony calms. Sigma now: {sigma}.

scenes.caption: A rename lands across {recipeFiles} files while {recipeHeld} agents hold edits: {recipeBack}.
scenes.sub: A person's recipe renamed formatPrice to formatAmount in {recipeCommits}. {recipeLanded} agent changes written with the old name landed with the new one. Merged with stock git, every one of those edits conflicts.

scenes.caption: One line hides in an 893-line change: everything else is reproduced, and the one line goes to a person.
scenes.sub: The change names the recipe that made it, so review replays the recipe and shows a person only what differs from its output. The same rename without that line lands on rule D5, with no model call.
